scope: Remaining complete original bodies in exact family cohort order; prerequisite review only.
linked_reference_caveat: Linked references, licenses, concrete input datasets and runtime dependencies remain separate uncompleted prerequisites unless recorded elsewhere.

sources.workflow: Map and preserve an existing financial workbook template, confirm historical inputs and units, populate formula-driven projections and supporting schedules in staged statements, and validate scenario-dependent cross-statement ties before delivery.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A licensed real workbook template, historical data or supplied extracted financials, assumptions and the requested staged confirmations. Actual Office JS inside Excel or a compatible standalone openpyxl environment plus the referenced recalculation mechanism is required. Any relevant reference and formula guide still needs review.
sources.offline_assessment: A bounded offline workbook task may be possible with public inputs and a real recalculation engine. Cached values, hardcoded projections or a JSON account summary cannot substitute for actual working spreadsheet formulas. The text has differing retained-earnings variants involving stock compensation; a future contract must resolve applicable assumptions before inference.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently inspect actual workbook formulas, preserved cells, references, units and styles; recalculate with an actual supported engine after changed assumptions and compare statement ties to independently derived accounting values. Pure XML inspection cannot establish recalculation, correctness of forecasts or regulatory compliance.

sources.workflow: Chain actual bond pricing, rate-curve and credit-curve calculations, decompose spread, obtain parallel-shift scenario results and synthesize a relative-value view with optional historical context.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Concrete instruments and pricing context, current authoritative curve and pricing data, and the named pricing, curve and scenario MCP tools with proper access. Callable-bond analysis needs the additional risk analytics. Tool illustrations are not observed or current values.
sources.offline_assessment: A declared arithmetic exercise on supplied historical snapshots is narrower than the specified tool-computation workflow. No actual pricing or curve runtime was provisioned, and missing market services are unresolved prerequisites, not evidence of failed bond analysis or a license to invent prices.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Reconcile genuine pricing and curve receipts, maturity interpolation, units and basis-point decomposition against an independent financial calculation and authoritative inputs. Scenario cash-flow or pricing replays are needed for numerical correctness; an asserted rich or cheap recommendation alone is not a ground truth.

sources.workflow: Use target-company facts and seller preferences to research strategic and financial acquirers, rank a buyer universe, map first-tier decision-maker contacts and deliver the required workbook and one-page summary.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A target brief with real business and valuation context, seller inclusion and exclusion preferences, reliable recent company and sponsor research, appropriate authority for contact data, and an actual workbook-writing environment. Capacity, fund deployment and activity are time-dependent.
sources.offline_assessment: A bounded workbook compilation from supplied public non-personal company records may be offline-capable. It cannot establish current buyer appetite, actual contact relationships, transaction likelihood or legal clearance. No outreach, account access or personal contact collection was performed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect actual workbook tabs, ordered tiers, summary totals and preservation of supplied company facts; verify research claims against independently supplied records. Human evaluation is needed for strategic fit and prioritization. The proposed buyer universe and contacts must not be treated as observed acquisition interest.

sources.workflow: Gather client and policy context, summarize actual portfolio and benchmark performance, compare allocation to targets and thresholds, and prepare the requested meeting summary, chart, agenda and action items.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Authorized account and policy data, period-specific holdings, cash flows and benchmark records, prior meeting context and any applicable firm requirements; compatible actual Word or PDF and chart tooling. No personal financial account or live tenant is authorized for this study.
sources.offline_assessment: An anonymized or public-input arithmetic and document-preparation task would need its own faithful, licensed fixture and scope. No account data was collected. A local draft cannot establish a completed client meeting, suitable personal advice, trade execution or regulatory compliance.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently derive the explicitly selected return, allocation and drift metrics from authentic test records and inspect the actual delivered document and chart. Validate source facts and thresholds separately from interpretive recommendations, which require an explicit expert rubric rather than self-reported suitability.

sources.workflow: Run one explicitly selected stage of a five-stage equity-coverage workflow: company research, financial workbook, valuation, chart package or final report assembly, checking the selected stage prerequisites and delivering its specified actual artifacts.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A concrete company and selected stage, complete stage-specific references and reliable research data. Later stages need the actual prior research, six-tab model, valuation and chart artifacts; the final stage names document and spreadsheet skills. Required content, chart counts and formats cannot be replaced by placeholders.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected stage may be offline-capable if every necessary public input and real runtime is provided. No such stage was executed here. The original insists on one stage per request and contains a later generic missing-prerequisite instruction that should not silently override that rule. A small summary is not the prescribed full report.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently inspect and recalculate real workbook and valuation outputs, verify factual citations and financial sources, and render or inspect the actual chart archive and final document for required content and counts. Expert judgment remains necessary for substantive investment research quality. Missing earlier stages remain prerequisites, not failed final-stage observations.

sources.workflow: Apply a trusted rules grid to an untrusted parsed applicant record and genuine screening results, derive a risk factor table, check required documents and cite each applicable rule before routing a disposition without granting final approval.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The structured parse, explicit trusted rules grid, screening results and any relevant evaluation date for document expiry. Actual screening-service results require proper access. The original distinguishes score-and-route output from human approval.
sources.offline_assessment: A bounded deterministic rules application could use entirely fictional public test records and supplied screening stubs explicitly labeled as such. That would not demonstrate actual sanctions screening, real onboarding, production regulatory compliance or customer approval. No real applicant data was accessed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently apply a frozen grid to each factor and expiry date, reconcile every rule identifier and applicable outcome, and test low-risk, missing-document and escalation cases plus inert instruction-like fields. Check actual output and the rule that clear requires low or medium risk, complete documents and no escalation; human approval stays outside the task.

sources.workflow: Treat the generated investor statement as the object under test, recompute its capital account from authoritative fund NAV components, compare every line within the declared tolerance and report flags without editing the statement.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real or explicitly constructed statement, authoritative NAV pack, prior ending balance, ownership fraction, contributions, distributions, fee and expense totals and any crystallized carry. Cross-period, aggregate NAV and commitment checks need their additional corresponding records.
sources.offline_assessment: A bounded offline reconciliation could be faithful on licensed public or explicitly fictional financial fixtures with the authoritative pack supplied as data. No NAV service or real investor record was used. Recomputing from the statement itself, omitting unavailable checks without explanation or substituting a self-reported pass would not implement the workflow.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Use independent exact-decimal arithmetic on the NAV source inputs and compare actual submitted per-line recomputations and flags, including tolerance boundaries, changed ownership and expenses, missing supplemental records and preservation of the original statement. Define rounding and the inclusive tolerance boundary before inference.

sources.workflow: Load or define an investment thesis, append dated evidence with pillar impact and conviction, maintain a falsifiable scorecard and catalyst calendar, and deliver an actual structured update or document.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The original thesis or an explicit new-company brief, concrete new evidence and dates, clear pillar and risk criteria, and a writable retained artifact if persistence is requested. Current claims require actual supplied evidence, not invented market developments.
sources.offline_assessment: A bounded preservation and evidence-log update may be possible offline with public company facts and a declared historical snapshot. A report does not verify investment suitability, future catalysts, trades or profitability. No investment account was accessed and no position changed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare actual before and after stored artifacts, preserved earlier evidence, dated new records and explicit pillar mapping against an independently supplied event set. An expert rubric is required for interpretive thesis strength and conviction; factual preservation alone cannot validate a recommendation.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
